title: P23: a new control inherited the environment it was meant to test (P14_MIN_FREE_GB=8 on InstaBox), and no task doc was written before execution
what_went_wrong: p23_a_negctl.sh built its 'variable unset' cases with a no-op line instead of unsetting the variable. On the Vultr box (variable not set) it passed 19/19 in the pre-flight and in the chain; on InstaBox, where the chain exports P14_MIN_FREE_GB=8, one case failed (18/1). The pre-flight ran only in the Vultr environment.
The scope of P23 was given in a chat question and no task doc was written before the run, unlike P18-P22.
root_cause: The control was pre-flighted in one environment; a control about an environment variable must be run with the variable unset AND set. The task doc step was skipped because the owner's go-ahead came quickly after the report.
impact: None on the driver or the results; fix-up cycle 1 (manifest b); the second machine's chain is otherwise green.

correction.applied: unset added inside the control; old frozen bytes reproduce the fault, new bytes 19/19 with the variable at 8 and unset on both machines; R5 section 36 states the missing task doc.

rule: Pre-flight a control that reads an environment variable with the variable unset and with it set; write the task doc before executing, even when the go-ahead is immediate.
